selection_rule: One independently phrased task query per occupation-linked candidate, written by a reviewer before running wave-three search; five unrelated no-answer controls.

queries.query: Our web survey never reached customers who use the offline service; can results describe everyone?
Recompute the carrier on-time score when missing delivery proof counts as late under the contract.
An old spare-part revision still fits supported repairs; how much inventory is actually stranded?
Satisfaction rose after the respondent mix shifted toward enterprise users; is the comparison valid?
Cases build up before packing although picking takes longer; which station limits flow?
Two ledger entries have the same amount but only one matches a source transaction; explain the remaining balance.
Overall conversion rises while every segment's conversion falls; explain the reversal.
The questionnaire asks whether onboarding is quick and easy in one rating; can we infer both?
Our process diagram omits the manual review seen in most case traces; compare the two.
All milestone tickets are closed but the signed acceptance artifact is missing; is it ready?
This quote used the new hourly tariff for work performed before the price change.
If testing moves next week, which resource bookings and customer handoffs are affected?
The dual approval policy exists, but did both reviewers sign the sampled purchases?
The patch shipped, yet the same customer action still errors; should the ticket close?
The tutorial works on main but references a command absent from the shipped version.
The setup instructions request a token before the step that creates it.
Set latency and failure criteria for checkout under peak load, including large carts.
Design cases for every allowed and forbidden order-status transition, including an interrupted capture.
Which fields from this new event feed may each team receive and retain?
Does this existing package preserve our required refusal semantics and schema version?

no_answer_queries: How should I prune an apple tree in winter?
What is the chemical formula of potassium permanganate?
Compose a sonnet about a blue whale.
Plan a family vacation in Lisbon.
